listing_info.listing_name: Classic Lodge with lake and mountain access!
listing_info.description:
Make some memories at this classic family-friendly lodge. Uniquely styled to help you leave the stress behind. Enjoy the lakes and mountains all from the comfort of Heights Lodge. Here you will enjoy a central location to the mountains where you can ski and hike, as well some of the best local farms in the lakes region. Although the shops and restaurants are only a few minutes away, the area feels peaceful and secluded.

The space
Every aspect of the space has been thoughtfully curated to ensure total guest satisfaction. We truly believe Varney Point is lakes region best kept secret.

While the home is equipped to to host 10 people, we think the ideal group size is 7-8. We are happy to host all 10, but please keep in mind it will be a little cozier.

Is that a cloud you're sleeping on? Nope, that's just the memory foam mattress we stock in every bedroom! So no need to draw straws on who sleeps where, because every room in the house is its own little sanctuary.

Sure, eating at the finest restaurants can be fun. But sometimes we all need a nice home-cooked meal, right? That's why our kitchen is fully stocked with all the essentials you'll need to cook you and your family a memorable dinner.

You are only:

5 mins to Bank of NH Pavilion
5 mins to Ellacoya State Park Beach
10 mins to Gunstock Mountain Resort
15 mins to Weirs Beach
20 mins to down town Meredith
25 mins to Tanger Outlets

Guest access
The entire property is yours to explore. Although the home sits on a smaller lot, the peninsula we are located on offers much to explore, including a local boat yard. Unfortunately the Gilford Public Beach is only for town residents. If you want a sandy beach to hang at, Ellacoya State Park Beach is only a few minutes down the road. There is a small charge to park. More information about the beach at Ellacoya State Park can be found at their website or through a quick google search.

You can also visit Weirs Beach, not only provides a fantastic place to swim but there is also great dining, shopping and entertainment.

Other things to note
Boat/canoe/kayak rental within walking distance to the home.
Boats can be temporarily docked at Fay's boat yard (walking distance from the home)

Please note: There shall be no charging of electric vehicles without permission from the owner.

Please note: The grill and fire pit are seasonal amenities.

Please note: Pack and play along with a high chair are available upon request.

listing_info.listing_name: Enjoy Fall Foliage at the Lake
listing_info.description:
Step out of the house and onto to a beautiful deck. From the deck to the water is just 30 feet of sandy beach! Located right on Pine River Pond, this 5-mile, 570 acre lake has crystal clear water. The gently sloping property makes it ideal for multi-generational families.

Swim in the summer, ice fish in the winter or just get away from it all in the fabulous peace and quiet of New Hampshire.

Note that June - August rentals are a minimum seven night stays Saturday - Saturday.

The space
Perfect for a couples weekend getaway. Side entrance split with 2 bedrooms upstairs and 2 bedrooms downstairs. Bedroom #1 has a queen bed. Bedroom #2 has two queen beds. Bedroom #3 has a queen bed. Bedroom #4 has two extra long twin beds. Full bathroom on each level. Great views down the lake from the kitchen table with Mt. Shaw (Castle in the Clouds) staring right at you.

Parking for 6 vehicles. Level 2 EV Charger.

In the winter, snowmobile or ice fish right from the property!

Beautiful waterfront home on 500+ acre Pine River Pond. Ice fish, snowshoe, snowmobile or just simply getaway and relax. The walk from the deck to the water is less just 30 feet! Gentle slopping sandy beach with crystal clear water (no water shoes needed).

Imagine sitting on the deck, having that morning cup of coffee, looking at the beautiful views of Mt. Shaw or watching the kids play on the sandy beach.

On most evenings and mornings, you'll be treated to the sound of the Loons currently calling Pine River Pond home. At night, while enjoying the campfire, walk to the dock, lay down and watch the stars. It's rare that you don't catch a glimpse of a shooting star.

Whether you’re sipping cocktails in the Adirondack chairs or napping after a round of golf, you'll be sure to truly relax on this vacation.

Modern kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances, dishwasher, microwave, trash compactor, washer/dryer, 1gb download wireless Internet, streaming TV/Netflix, Amazon Prime, blender, toaster, ceiling fans, inside & outside stereo speakers, gas grill with stainless steel grates, hammock, private 40' dock, 2 picnic tables, 100' of waterfront beach. Parking for 6 cars with Level 2 EV charger.

Fish, golf, ski or relax: excellent snowshoeing and cross country skiing right off the property. Golf, skiing and hiking are less then 20 minutes. Snowmobile trails (Seven Lakes Snowmobile Club) right off the property. Amazing fall foliage. and winter ice fishing.

North Conway outlet shops and White Mountains are 45 minutes north. Wolfboro and Lake Winnipesaukee 20 minutes west. Horseback riding close by.

We have great rental history and reviews, offering our home to guests for over 15 years.

Visit These Web sites:
Castle in the Clouds
Story Land
Splashtown/Funtown
York's Wild Kingdom
Cannon Aerial Tramway
Attitash Mountain
Flume Gorge
Kittery Outlets
Mt Washington Auto Road

We hope that you enjoy the beauty and tranquility of our home and Pine River Pond. With future generations in mind, our home uses LED lighting, high efficiency furnace, instant hot water heater and has new thermal windows. We have an Electric Vehicle, Level 2 charger and recycle plastic, cardboard, aluminum and metal cans. Due to its characteristic as both sustainable and biodegradable, we choose wood for our siding, as well as the interior walls and ceilings of our home The property is landscaped so as to minimize any potential rain water run-off into the lake and we have been awarded the Lake Smart Award by NH Lakes.

New Hampshire License #104325

Guest access
You have the entire house to yourselves. Canoe and 4 kayaks are provided. 40 ft dock. Horseshoe pits, tetherball, corn hole, beach chairs, all for your use. Fire-pit on the beach with firewood provided with the rental.

We also have a 14' skiff with 15hp engine available for an additional rental fee.

Keyless entry.

Other things to note
Beds will be made-up upon your arrival. Bath towels, paper towels, toilet paper, soap, shampoo and cleaning products are all provided.

Upon departure, please put used sheets and towels in laundry bags provided and leave in bedrooms. Blankets and comforters can remain on the beds.

No more then 10 overnight guest, including children.

Please put any items moved during your stay back in their original spot and broom sweep the house

listing_info.listing_name: Great Getaway! Gunstock 20 min dr! Beach 2 min dr!
listing_info.description:
Relax with the whole family at this peaceful getaway.
Enjoy 4 spacious bedrooms, two cozy living rooms, fun family games, and a large deck perfect for gathering.
Located just minutes from downtown Alton, NH. Local restaurants and ice cream shops close by.
Private beach at the lake 2 mins drive!!!
Explore nearby gems: Wolfeboro, Gunstock Mountain (21 min), Lake Winnipesaukee (10 min), Ellacoya State Park (20 min).
The perfect base for year-round family fun in the lakes & mountains region!

Home with wraparound deck, peaceful surroundings, access to a shared association beach. Great family getaway on its own or as overflow for your large group if you are interested in our other properties which include the abutting property with heated, saltwater pool (see links to other properties in notes) - all within walking (5min) or quick drive (1min) away distance. Enjoy all four seasons at this special property!

listing_info.listing_name: Bear Point - 4 Bedroom home on the water
listing_info.description: Welcome to Bear Point! With multiple decks overlooking your own private swim area on Balch Lake, you and your friends or family can enjoy all this four-season home and the lakes region of New Hampshire have to offer. Experience Bear Point in the fall or winter and come back to enjoy summer on the lake!

This newly renovated single family home offers the a huge yard surrounded by woods yet it is close to everything. With four bedrooms and two full bathrooms it is perfect for groups and families. The home features free wifi, coffee bar, firepit with free firewood, and a family room with shuffleboard table and arcade game.

The space
19 Mile Bay-Tuftonboro - 4 bedroom, 2 full bath newly renovated home for lease. Amenities include: minutes to the town beach, huge yard, grill, stainless steel kitchen, coffee bar with Keurig, arcade machines, and board games

The kitchen has spices and all the basics for family cooking. Please feel free to take the book you start reading if you haven’t finished it by the end of vacation.

Garage not included.

Guest access
We will provide a code to the door a few days prior to your arrival. Note the renters agreement must be completed prior to the access code being provided.

If you have not completed the renters agreement as of the day of arrival you may only check in up to 8 p.m. and only after they are completed. We recommend completing it as soon as booking so that you are free to check in at any time that is convenient for you after 4 pm on the day of arrival.

Other things to note
Ms. Pac-Man cocktail table with Dig Dug, board games, yard games, family friendly, shuffle board table, coffee, full kitchen with all the basics, gas grill and huge yard. We provide all of the linens for registered guests, an electric fireplace, coffee pouches and basic toiletries. There is free wifi throughout and a smart television.

listing_info.listing_name: Lakes Region Chalet | Firepit + Gunstock View
listing_info.description:
You arrive as the mountains rise around you, and the stresses of life begin to fade. Summit View Chalet becomes your home base for lake days, ski mornings, and cozy nights in. Mornings bring big plans, days fill with adventure, and evenings slow into laughter, warm meals, and stories shared together. Built for families and friends, it’s a place to relax, reconnect, and let the Lakes Region set the rhythm of your stay no matter what season!

The space
Step inside and feel the house open up around you, light moving through the rooms and space unfolding for everyone to settle in. Just minutes from Gunstock Mountain Resort, with a peek of the mountain in the distance, this home welcomes up to 10 guests into a setting built for connection, comfort, and easy living.

Mornings begin in quiet bedrooms with soft light and slow starts, while the day unfolds into shared adventures and spontaneous plans. The open living spaces invite everyone together, whether it’s laughter over coffee, foosball tournaments, board games, or movie nights that stretch long after dark. The recreation room becomes a natural gathering place, full of energy and conversation, while the main living areas offer calm, cozy spaces to unwind.

Outside, the deck becomes your evening hub, where grilling turns into long dinners and conversations drift under open skies. Inside, the kitchen anchors the home with everything you need for simple breakfasts, big family meals, and late-night snacks around the table.

From quiet mornings to full, lively evenings, this is a space designed for togetherness, rest, and memory-making. Adventure outside, comfort inside, and a home that makes every moment in between feel effortless.

Where you'll sleep:
Sleeping Arrangements
• Bedroom 1: King bed
• Bedroom 2: Queen bed
• Bedroom 3: King bed
• Bedroom 4: Twin over Full Bunkbed
• Game Room: Full sleeper sofa

Guest access
The entire home is yours to enjoy, from the welcoming living spaces to the quiet corners made for slowing down. Step outside into a spacious private backyard that feels like an extension of the house, perfect for morning coffee, evening conversations, or gathering everyone together after a full day of exploring. Parking is easy and stress-free with plenty of space, including a large driveway and convenient side parking, so everyone arrives and settles in without a second thought.

Other things to note
This is a family-friendly home designed for shared stays and relaxing getaways.
Quiet hours begin at 10:00 PM in respect of the residential neighborhood.
No parties or events are permitted.
Guests must be respectful of neighbors and wildlife common to the area.
The bunk bed is best suited for children or younger guests.
Please use the deck, grill, and outdoor spaces responsibly and clean up after use.
The home is professionally cleaned prior to each stay for your comfort.

✅ Good News! Your stay includes coverage for accidental damage and mishaps. We take your safety and security seriously, and this property has special local compliance requirements of a signed rental agreement and ID verification. To make this easy for you, we use a secure and very simple, app-free platform called Happy Guest. It is not an app, and you do not have to sign up for an account — it’s a safe and secure website. It also gives you a guest portal with all the info about the home and all of my favorite local spots.

listing_info.listing_name: Spacious, Dog Friendly Rental in Wolfeboro NH!
listing_info.description:
Four-bedrooms, and dog friendly! Rust Pond water access at the very end of the property. Close to Gunstock Ski Mountain and King Pine Skiing. Less than an hour to ski Mount Cranmore. Access to the snowmobile trails, ice fishing. Downtown Wolfeboro one mile away to shop! Two bedrooms, 2 decks, living room & kitchen with all your amenities, One King bed and 3 Queen beds. Enjoy outdoor fire pits, and a very large yard, also a beautiful full-service restaurant located on premise, called Trenta.

The space
The condo is upstairs above our newly open restaurant, Trenta, and has stair access only. Upon your stay, you will have access to the entire four-bedroom condo and what it has to offer...

Guest access
The whole Inn

Other things to note
House Rules:
-No Smoking
-No parties or events
- All beds must be stripped down and items put into the laundry basket in the designated room this includes towels, sheets, fitted sheets, and pillowcases. Please fold the comforter and place it next to the laundry basket
- Patio chairs need to be brought inside upon departure.
-Enjoy!

listing_info.listing_name: Year round fun for everyone at Cardinal Crossing!
listing_info.description:
*Brand New Listing!*
Directly on the water, this spacious home offers the perfect blend of high-energy adventure and lakeside relaxation. With 4 bedrooms, there is plenty of room for everyone to spread out, while our 1 full bathroom plus a convenient half-bath makes getting ready a breeze.
​Offering an open living area with views of the water plus a fully equipped kitchen for post-adventure meals.
​We are a four-season destination. Summer swimming or winter snowmobiling, you'll love it!

The space
Welcome to the Lake! We are so happy to have you at our waterfront retreat. Whether you’re here for the glassy morning lake or the fresh winter trails, we hope you find some adventure.

Pack only clothes and food, we've got the rest covered! Towels for the shower and more for the beach, linens with extra sets for each bed, and fully ready kitchens (indoor and out) for all your cooking needs!

​Feel free to use the dock for swimming, fishing, and sunbathing. Our shallow beach is perfect for all ages. 2 kayaks, 2 paddleboards, a canoe, and life jackets for adults and kids are provided.
If you brought a boat, the public launch is minutes away at Balch Lake Marina.

​Staying in the winter, there is direct access to snowmobile trails, and skiing at King Pine is near by.

Guest access
You'll have the place to yourself. Access to the home is done via key pad so you can come and go at your leisure.

Other things to note
The house is on a well and after rainstorms can cause a sulfur smell some times from the water. The water has been tested and is safe, and the refrigerator has additional filtration. Also, while being out in the middle of nowhere is very calming and quiet, you might run into some deer, bugs and other wild animals. There is a bug zapper on the corner of the deck with on and off switch for your convenience.

listing_info.listing_name: Lakefront Alton Bay Retreat w/ Dock Near Beaches!
listing_info.description:
Discover the shores of Lake Winnipesaukee at this 4-bedroom, 2-bath vacation rental! Boasting miles of public beaches, marinas, restaurants, and more, this Alton Bay home is the perfect spot for your family’s next getaway! Prepare a hearty breakfast in the mornings, and then take a boat out on the water or hop aboard Mount Washington for a scenic cruise. If you’re seeking family-friendly activities, head out to Funspot for arcade games and mini-golf or Monkey Trunks for ziplining courses.

The space
NH Room and Meals Tax License #102801 | 1,920 Sq Ft | Boat Dock for 20’ Boat (One Boat Allowed) | Near Public Beach & Town Boat Launch

Bedroom 1: King Bed | Bedroom 2: Twin XL Bed, Twin Bed | Bedroom 3: Queen Bed | Bedroom 4: Twin XL Bed, Twin Bed

MAIN FEATURES: Lake access, Smart TVs, Blu-ray player, 2 dining areas, beach chairs/towels, board games, books
KITCHEN: Cooking basics, refrigerator, microwave, stove/oven, dishwasher, dishware & flatware, blender, coffee maker, toaster, toaster oven, spices
GENERAL: Free WiFi (300 Mbps), central A/C & heating, towels/linens, in-unit laundry, hair dryer, hangers, trash bags/paper towels, complimentary toiletries
FAQ: Stairs required to access, grab rails in showers, 4 exterior security cameras (facing out), boats not provided
PARKING: Garage (2 vehicles), driveway (2 vehicles), parking behind the home (3 vehicles), boats/trailers allowed on-site

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property via keyless entry

Other things to note
- No smoking or vaping of any kind
- No pets allowed
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in
- NOTE: The property requires stairs to access
- NOTE: Boats not provided
- NOTE: Your safety matters. This property features 4 exterior security cameras: camera 1 is facing the back door entrance, camera 2 is facing the side and front door entrance, camera 3 is facing the back of the house, and camera 4 is facing the left side of the house. The cameras do not look into interior spaces. The cameras record video and sound when activated by motion. They will record when they first sense motion and 30 seconds after the last motion is detected
- NOTE: Please close the propane tank after using the grill
